'''Red Alpha''' was [[Andrephan Stormcaller]]'s primary insertion team when he worked for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. When he left the Alliance to form the [[Red Moons]], many Red Alpha members followed him.
